standard_process: Acknowledge receipt and thank the customer for the report
Attempt to reproduce the issue using the details provided (steps, screenshots, environment)
Check the known-issues tracker for a matching open bug
If reproducible and new, file a ticket with Engineering and tag it with a severity level
If a known workaround exists, share it with the customer immediately
Notify the customer once a fix ships, or provide an ETA if the issue is still open
If the customer is pro/enterprise tier and impact was material, evaluate service credit eligibility per BUGCREDIT-01
escalation_trigger: Bug blocks core product functionality for multiple customers, causes data loss, or affects an enterprise-tier account

standard_process: Verify the customer's identity and pull recent billing history
Identify the specific charge(s) in dispute
Check refund eligibility against REFUND-01
Issue a refund or credit if eligible, or clearly explain why the charge is valid if not
Document the resolution on the customer's account record
Follow up within 48 hours to confirm the issue is resolved to the customer's satisfaction
escalation_trigger: Disputed amount exceeds $500, or the customer has 2+ prior unresolved billing complaints within 90 days

standard_process: Acknowledge the request and thank the customer for the feedback
Check the product roadmap and feature-request backlog for an existing matching entry
Log a new backlog entry if none exists, tagging the requesting customer and tier
Set expectations clearly: no guaranteed timeline is given
Close the ticket — no refund or compensation action applies
escalation_trigger: Requested by 5+ enterprise customers within 90 days, or requested directly by an enterprise account's executive sponsor

standard_process: Thank the customer personally and acknowledge the specific thing they praised
Log the feedback for the relevant team (product, support, or success) for visibility
Flag to Customer Success as a potential reference or testimonial candidate if the customer is pro or enterprise tier
Close the ticket — no further action required
Review account history: tenure, lifetime value, recent tickets, and usage trend
Identify the root cause of dissatisfaction from the feedback text
Check retention offer eligibility per tier under CHURN-01
Proactively reach out with a retention offer or a concrete resolution plan
Escalate to the assigned Account Manager if the customer is enterprise tier
Log the outcome (retained, churned, or pending) for churn analytics regardless of result
escalation_trigger: Enterprise-tier account, lifetime value above $10,000, or the customer explicitly states intent to cancel

standard_process: Do not take the reported content or behavior at face value — verify against account activity logs
Check ABUSE-01 for the specific violation type
Determine severity tier: warning, suspension, or termination
Apply the appropriate action per policy and document the justification on the account
Notify Trust & Safety for any suspension or termination decision before it is applied
Respond to the reporting customer, if applicable, without disclosing details of the other account
escalation_trigger: Any report involving fraud, harassment, illegal content, or a repeat violation by the same account

standard_process: Read the inquiry and confirm it genuinely has no clearer category
Answer directly using available policy or help-center knowledge if the question is straightforward
If it requires specialist knowledge, route it to the appropriate team
Close the ticket once the customer's question has been answered
escalation_trigger: Inquiry cannot be answered from existing policy or documentation after initial triage
